question.problem: An arithmetic sequence has ${a}_{20}=21.5$ and ${a}_{24}=12.5.$ What is the common difference of the sequence?
question.worked_solution:
The first thing to note is that the terms are *decreasing*, and therefore we expect $d$ to be *negative*.

We are given the terms

$$
{a}_{20}=21.5,\,{a}_{24}=12.5.
$$

To find $d,$ we apply the formula with $n=24$ and $m=20:$

$$
\begin{aligned}d & =\frac{{a}_{n}-{a}_{m}}{n-m} \\  & =\frac{{a}_{24}-{a}_{20}}{24-20} \\  & =\frac{12.5-21.5}{24-20} \\  & =\frac{-9}{4} \\  & =-2.25\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the common difference is $d=-2.25.$
